# Diogo Silva — Full Context (llms-full.txt)

> Diogo Bronze Silva (publicly signing as Diogo Silva) is a Senior Account Executive in B2B SaaS and FinTech based near Fátima, Portugal, living with his wife, Sara, and their five children. He is an essayist in English and Portuguese on enterprise sales, AI workflows, philosophy, theology and family, and a documentary photographer under the name Bronze Art.
> Canonical Home URL: https://diogobronzesilva.com/
> Work & Career Profile URL: https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/
> Contact: hello@diogobronzesilva.com

---

## 1. Identity, Background and Experience

- **Full Name**: Diogo Bronze Silva
- **Public Signature**: Diogo Silva
- **Location**: Near Fátima, Portugal
- **Markets**: Portugal, EMEA, UK&I
- **Languages**: Portuguese (`pt-PT`) and English (`en`)
- **Family**: Married to Sara; father of five children.
- **Current Position**: Senior Account Executive at Coverflex (FinTech / employee compensation & benefits)
- **Role Focus**: B2B software sales, enterprise qualification and Deal Intelligence
- **Career Trajectory**: Over a decade in B2B SaaS across new business, expansion and customer growth in Portugal, EMEA and the UK&I.
  - **Coverflex**: Works with founders, finance directors and HR teams at Portuguese companies on compensation, benefits and employee budgets.
  - **deskbird**: New business, adoption and retention across EMEA and the UK and Ireland.
  - **Pipedrive**: Software sales across qualification, pipeline management and closing.
- **Speaking**: Featured guest on *The Daily Sales* LinkedIn Live — "Live Sales Insights with Diogo Silva" (2022).

## 2. B2B Sales and Deal Intelligence

- **Source**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/
- **Sales practice**: Help software buyers work through the decision, including how their business operates, who needs to take part and what they need to know before buying.
- **Deal Intelligence**: Language models bring together call notes, procurement documents and questions from stakeholders. Pricing calculations and financial checks use rules that can be verified.
- **Human review**: Diogo reviews the source and the brief before deciding what to use, record in the CRM or send.

## 3. Projects and Software Applications

- **Overview Page**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/

### AI Sales Systems and Custom Workflows
- **Project URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/#ai-sales-workflows
- **Scope**: Personal B2B sales workflows for account research and meeting preparation, follow-up and CRM updates. Diogo reviews the source material before deciding what to record or send.

### Bronze Art
- **Project URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/bronze-art-galleries/
- **Photography Portfolio**: https://bronzeart.pt/ (Portuguese) and https://bronzeart.pt/en (English). The portfolio and booking enquiries are public. Client albums and downloads are accessed via private links.
- **Delivery Application**: Custom web application built around Diogo's photographic delivery workflow: browsing a finished chaptered story, downloading final high-resolution JPEGs and making album selections.
- **Workflow**: Ordinary JPEG folders, chapter-based presentation, resumable uploads, review before publishing, and separate actions for adding or replacing photographs.
- **Access**: Used within Bronze Art. Client access has an expiry and is separate from the author's internal archive. Client links and private family photographs are not published on the personal site. A recipient can forward a delivery link.

### Bronze Clinical
- **Project URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/bronze-clinical/
- **Scope**: Photography, video, clinical writing and web development for private medical and dental clinics in Portugal, with one point of contact.
- **Delivery**: A complete website or a project for one priority specialty. Existing visual material can be carried across. The clinic owns the domain, content, code and media after launch. Ongoing support is optional.
- **Process**: A five-page technical review covers mobile measurements, the booking route and regulatory information. A 30–45-minute interview with the clinical director informs copy, with one day on site if new visuals are required. Single-site work typically takes about 15 days. Multi-site schedules are phased.
- **Technical work**: Mobile performance, booking integrations, searchable insurance information, structured medical data, review of how the website presents Portuguese healthcare requirements, and checks on DNS and email before moving a domain.

### VitaChart
- **Project URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/vitachart/
- **Fictional journal demonstration**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/ (VitaChart 1.3.2, with a selectable example diary for Creighton or Billings and each method’s current chart and PDF).
- VitaChart in Portuguese. [Project](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/vitachart/pt/) · [Web demo](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/pt/).
- VitaChart in Spanish. [Project](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/vitachart/es/) · [Web demo](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/es/).
- VitaChart in French. [Project](https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/vitachart/fr/) · [Web demo](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/fr/).
- **Privacy**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/privacy/ (Portuguese) and https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/app/privacy-en.html (English).
- VitaChart guide and support: [Português](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/apoio/), [English](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/apoio/en/), [Español](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/apoio/es/), [Français](https://diogobronzesilva.com/vitachart/apoio/fr/). Getting started, consultation PDFs, backups and recovery.
- **Product brand**: Bronze App.
- **Category**: Personal fertility diary (Android, iPhone and installable web version).
- **Background**: Grew out of the family’s fertility charting with a FertilityCare practitioner and NaProTechnology doctor. VitaChart is an independent application.
- **Creighton**: Standardised observation codes and stamps, with P for Peak Day. Earlier Creighton records keep their original notation.
- **Billings**: A dedicated form for vulval sensation, visible discharge and the Basic Infertile Pattern (BIP), with × for a confirmed Peak in the chart and PDF.
- **Shared tools**: English, Portuguese, Spanish and French, local reminders, consultation notes, PDF and CSV / Excel export, and JSON backup and restore.
- **Storage and sharing**: No mandatory online account, advertising or third-party analytics. The journal is stored locally; exports are initiated by the user. Standard JSON and CSV exports are readable. The app also supports password-protected backups. Remote couple synchronisation and encrypted pairing are future work, not current features.
- **Status**: Released for iPhone, with availability varying by country. Android release is planned. The web demo runs 1.3.2. Check the project page for store availability. The iPhone listing is at https://apps.apple.com/app/vitachart-fertility-cycle/id6835496784. Automated interpretations remain under validation and require professional review.

### Cutline
- **Project URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/cutline/
- **Purpose**: A personal Mac application that prepares a first editorial selection of short clips from long videos for human review.
- **Features**: Local Whisper transcription, up to ten suggested moments, face or subject framing, 9:16 video, 1080 × 1920 MP4 and separate editable SRT captions.
- **Local processing**: Runs transcription and rendering on the Mac without a mandatory account, subscription or AI API key. Fetching a linked video and downloading the model initially need a connection.
- **Platform and scope**: Apple silicon, macOS 13.5 or later. The original code is proprietary. No installer is distributed from the personal website. Use owned or authorised source material.

## 4. Bronze Art (Photography)

- **Website**: https://bronzeart.pt/
- **Focus**: Classical, documentary photography of family, faith, liturgy, and what is handed down between generations.
- **Philosophy**: Preserving ordinary, sacred, and generational memory through timeless black-and-white and archival photographic craft.

## 5. Published Notes and Essays

All essays are published in static HTML on https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/.

### "Even a castle in the sky needs roots" (14 Nov 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/even-a-castle-in-the-sky-needs-roots/
- **Summary**: A real question from one of Diogo’s children about the blue stone in Castle in the Sky opens a reflection on Laputa, Swift, technological power and rootedness. The gardener robot connects the film to AI, the purpose of saved time, family, faith and care for the living world. Babel and Atlantis are presented as the author’s interpretive echoes.

### "What remains when the world turns" (11 Nov 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/what-remains-when-the-world-turns/
- **Summary**: Five illustrated family portraits in imagined worlds begin an English essay on identity, family, faith and changing circumstances. With an autumnal literary cadence and restrained humour, it distinguishes substance and accidents, explains Eucharistic transubstantiation as the conversion of bread and wine into Our Lord's Body and Blood, and reflects on moral growth, professional ambition, daily duties and the people by whom one hopes to remain recognisable.

### "The end of the information broker" (9 Nov 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-end-of-the-information-broker/
- **Summary**: A practical essay on the future of the B2B Account Executive (2026–2030) and why artificial intelligence in complex enterprise sales should eliminate administrative noise rather than automate cold outreach. It details a three-layer Deal Intelligence architecture (prioritising CRM historical context over static web snapshots, pairing LLM MEDDPICC audits with zero-error deterministic fiscal code for TSU and benefit calculations, and generating a 30-second executive pre-call brief), defines an objective pipeline Temperature score separate from Account Tier, and argues that when digital channels are commoditised, physical presence in the field becomes the true luxury.

### "The wisdom of a second breakfast" (29 Oct 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-wisdom-of-a-second-breakfast/
- **Summary**: A conversation about buttered toast and tea leads to Tolkien's hobbits, second breakfast, and the wisdom of recognising a good day while living it. The essay connects work and ambition with family, hospitality, nature, photography, gratitude and the attention ordinary life deserves.

### "Saber ler a sala" (11 Oct 2026, pt-PT)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/saber-ler-a-sala/
- **Summary**: A reflection on career, leadership, communication, and trust sparked by a LinkedIn post about Cristiano Ronaldo. The essay examines the ability to hear sincere criticism, accept changing roles with humility, and communicate publicly in ways that protect rather than erode a team's shared trust.

### "The life I would not trade" (29 Sep 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-life-i-would-not-trade/
- **Summary**: Watching two versions of Jason Dessen live with different choices in Dark Matter prompts a reflection on career ambition and family life. The note considers the ordinary time shared with children, the bonds built through repeated presence, and the kind of personal and spiritual wealth professional success cannot replace.

### "The work that holds the rest" (25 Sep 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-work-that-holds-the-rest/
- **Summary**: Modern convenience tempts us into an illusion of self-sufficiency. Originating in a conversation with his eldest son about what happens before bread reaches the family table, this note explores how both family peace and enterprise success rest entirely on an invisible foundation of manual and operational labour. True professional maturity and leadership require recognising that dignity belongs to all honest work, and that the highest form of respect is active awareness.

### "A impossibilidade de separar costumes e economia" (14 Sep 2026, pt-PT)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/a-impossibilidade-de-separar-costumes-e-economia/
- **Summary**: There is no morally neutral economy. The modern slogan "socially conservative, economically liberal" is an artificial division: the way we work, consume, hire and invest inevitably shapes the cultural habits and family stability we claim to protect. Drawing on Catholic Social Teaching, economics must serve human dignity, the family, and God, rather than reducing human life to production and consumption.

### "Rumo ao Deserto" (7 Sep 2026, pt-PT)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/rumo-ao-deserto/
- **Summary**: Disengaging from the world's noise is not abandoning concrete duties; it is recovering interior silence, prayer, and clear judgment in a culture that demands constant distraction.

### "Deus e o Belo" (31 Aug 2026, pt-PT)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/deus-e-o-belo/
- **Summary**: If God is Being itself, beauty is not a pious ornament: it is an objective reflection of the order, truth, and goodness that all created things receive from Him.

### "The ability to leave work" (24 Aug 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-ability-to-leave-work/
- **Summary**: Ambition becomes livable when work is assigned its proper boundary: important enough to perform with excellence, but limited enough to leave behind each evening for home and family.

### "Things parenthood teaches you about people" (19 Aug 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/parenthood-teaches-you-about-people/
- **Summary**: Raising children provides essential lessons for professional and community life: apologize sincerely, safeguard trust, and never punish curiosity for being inconvenient.

### "What ten years can build" (18 Aug 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/what-ten-years-can-build/
- **Summary**: Most enduring achievements in marriage, family, character and career are built quietly through ordinary daily habits sustained over a decade.

### "Work educates" (14 Aug 2026, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/work-educates/
- **Summary**: Certain trades and demanding physical or intellectual work teach virtues that verbal explanations cannot: consequence, patience, accountability, and the quiet pride of good craftsmanship.

### "Escassez de trabalhadores qualificados" (8 Jul 2022, pt-PT)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/escassez-de-trabalhadores-qualificados/
- **Summary**: The shortage of skilled labor in Portugal stems from structural factors: declining birth rates, an educational system misaligned with genuine market demand, and a cultural aversion to entrepreneurial risk.

### "Bitcoin | The Fairy Tale" (20 Jun 2022, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/bitcoin-the-fairy-tale/
- **Summary**: No monetary architecture or decentralized ledger removes the fallibility inherent in human exchange, because the imperfection resides in human nature, not the ledger.

### "Panem et circenses" (25 Feb 2022, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/panem-et-circenses/
- **Summary**: Social media algorithms incentivize performative moral outrage, rewarding the appearance of virtue over the difficult pursuit of truth and quiet goodness.

### "The Reign of Quantities" (10 Dec 2021, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/the-reign-of-quantities/
- **Summary**: True quality demands craftsmanship, patience, and time. Mass production prioritizes speed and volume, sacrificing depth in goods, architecture, and thought.

### "Efficiency, the One Ring to rule them all" (22 Nov 2021, en)
- **URL**: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/efficiency-the-one-ring/
- **Summary**: Efficiency has no built-in moral ceiling. When pursued as an ultimate end rather than a means, it ceases serving human life and begins demanding that human life serve it.

## 7. Technical Architecture

Canonical section pages:
- Home: https://diogobronzesilva.com/
- Work: https://diogobronzesilva.com/work/
- Projects: https://diogobronzesilva.com/projects/
- Notes: https://diogobronzesilva.com/notes/
- Contact: https://diogobronzesilva.com/contact/


- **Format**: Hand-crafted static HTML5 and CSS. A small local JavaScript file is limited to the fictional VitaChart demonstration, with a readable static example as fallback. No analytics or tracking. The interactive app demo accepts fictional entries and stores them in the visitor’s browser.
- **Structured Entity & Article Markup**: Every published page embeds a self-contained canonical `#person` JSON-LD node (`Diogo Silva` / `Diogo Bronze Silva`, `Senior Account Executive` at `Coverflex`, Fátima, Portugal, `sameAs` links), `ProfilePage` on `/` and `/work/`, per-section Open Graph images including `/assets/img/og/work.jpg`, and standardized `BlogPosting` JSON-LD (`wordCount`, `timeRequired`, `articleSection`, Lisbon timezone stamps) plus `article:*` Open Graph properties across all 18 essays.
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Pages / Edge static hosting.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/diogobronzesilva-arch/DiogoBronzeSilva
- **Discovery**: Static public HTML, canonical URLs, sitemap, structured data and internal links. robots.txt permits crawlers; indexing and search inclusion are decisions made by each service. llms files are context documents, not ranking guarantees.
